title: 烈風のストライク・ルート
author: 甲斐 走

en.title: Gale Force Strike Route
en.premise: Ren is a boy fueled by passion for "Sky Ball," a high-speed sport played on flying ships. However, cursed with an inability to lie, he struggles in a game where strategic bluffs and feints are essential, leaving him distrusted by his teammates and broken. But after crossing paths with a weak team of fellow misfits, Ren sets out to prove that the truth can be the most powerful weapon of all.

zh.title: 烈风的强击路线
zh.premise: 少年伦对在飞空船赛场上展开的超高速球类运动——“天空球”充满热情。然而，由于身负“无法撒谎的诅咒”，在极度依赖战略性虚招与假动作的这项竞技中，他无法获得队友的信任而陷入挫折。直到他遇见了一支由不合群的边缘人们组成的弱小球队，他决定证明，“真实”才是最强的武器。
